collection: AI Lab multi-source image library coverage
policy: Every source from the visual reference guide has an explicit status. Downloaded files are hashed and dimension-checked. Reference-only or not-downloaded sources are never presented as reusable licensed assets.

sources.name: Open Doodles
sources.notes: 33 SVG + 20 PNG are already tracked by the dedicated manifest; this source catalog points to that verified batch.

sources.name: Open Peeps
sources.notes: Local CDN files downloaded from the official Webflow page; 219 image/SVG files retained for learning and reusable compositions.

sources.name: unDraw
sources.license: unDraw free license; MIT transport package
sources.notes: Three SVG files extracted from undraw-svg@2.0.0; the package and source terms are retained in the manifest.
